prompt_freeze_rationale: Pass-level decision-family agreement is high (92/100 pairs share the same category), answerability agreement is 91/100, and the adjudicator resolved every disagreement from visible evidence. The one recurring issue was in the comparison rubric, not the prompts: char-3-gram similarity misclassified same-family wording differences as major disagreements and generic prohibited-step wording differences as conflicts. The rubric was refined (longest-common-prefix+Jaccard similarity, conflict-only prohibited-step check) and comparisons re-derived from the unchanged cached pass records; no annotation was regenerated and no prompt changed.
recurring_issues: the two passes frequently choose the same decision family with different specific wording (73/100 minor disagreements); the adjudicator accepts both in most cases, so the frozen gold labels carry richer acceptable-alternative sets
9/100 tasks had answerability disagreements and 4/100 had scoreability splits; all were adjudicated
no policy_verified=true labels were produced and no fabricated policy entered any label
2/100 tasks are unscored (insufficient_context) and are excluded from business denominators
